panel.description: Switch between UI panels/tabs (input, metrics, viewers, report)

viewer.window.description: CT window width (contrast range). Higher = more contrast.

viewer.level.description: CT window level (center HU). Lower = darker, higher = brighter.

viewer.zoom.description: Viewer zoom level in percent. Use set with an absolute value between 50 and 300; use increase/decrease with a positive delta between 1 and 250; fit only resets the camera/view to fit. This changes image magnification, not the viewer panel size.

viewer.fullscreen.description: Click the viewer card expand/maximize button and toggle that card to fill the Viewers panel. Use value=3d for 'enlarge/maximize the 3D viewer' or '全屏放大三维查看器'. This changes panel layout, not camera fit or numeric zoom.

viewer.reset.description: Reset all viewer settings (window/level/zoom/pan) to defaults

viewer.fit_all.description: Fit all 2D viewers to show the full image

viewer.refresh_planning.description: Reload the active Session's saved planning result into the Viewer and Data Tree, including available seeds, needles, dose overlay, isodose surfaces, DVH, and surgical guide. This is a display-only refresh; it does not rerun planning or recompute dose.

viewer.reconstruct3d.description: Run the global 3D reconstruction action from the Viewer toolbar using the currently loaded CT and planning data. This is the toolbar action, not the per-organ Data Tree reconstruction command.

viewer.transform.description: Apply a 2D viewer transform or history action without changing the image coordinate chain

mask.create.description: Start a new manual mask and enter the Draw tool. Paint on the 2D slices; the mask appears under Segmentation > Masks in the Data Tree.

mask.finalize.description: Finalise the currently active manual mask (same as clicking the Draw tool again).

mask.threshold.description: Create/replace a threshold mask in the Data Tree from HU > value (display-only, never used for dose).

mask.rename.description: Rename a mask by id (e.g. mask_1). Value is JSON {"id":"mask_1","name":"My Mask"}.

mask.move.description: Reclassify a mask as display CTV or OAR (presentation only). Value is JSON {"id":"mask_1"}.

mask.delete.description: Delete a mask by id (value: mask_1).

viewer.colorbar.description: Set or reset the dose colorbar. Value is JSON such as {"scope":"twoD","min":0,"max":600,"palette":"hot"}.

viewer.dose_scale.description: Set dose display scale and palette using the viewer.colorbar JSON format

overlay.display_mode.description: Display mode: ct=CT only, overlay=CT+label, label=label only

slice.axial.description: Navigate axial slice. Value is slice index.

viewer.dose_peak.description: Move all three 2D viewers to the axial, sagittal, and coronal slices containing the maximum dose voxel. Requires a loaded dose overlay.

data_tree.description: Expand, collapse, or toggle any mounted Data Tree group. expand_all/collapse_all affects all groups.

tree.reconstruct3d.description: 3D reconstruct an organ node. Value: organ_id (e.g. 'ctv_1', 'organ_52')

tree.group.visibility.description: Toggle visibility for an entire data-tree group. Value is 'group_name,show' or 'group_name,hide'. Valid groups include ctv, oar, non_traversable, traversable, masks, planning_trajectories, planning_seeds, planning_needles, planning_meshes, planning_artifacts.

tree.group.opacity.description: Set opacity for an entire group. Value: 'group_name,0-100'

tree.group.reconstruct3d.description: 3D reconstruct all organs in a group. Value: group name (e.g. 'oar', 'non_traversable')

tree.dose.visibility.description: Toggle dose overlay visibility in data tree

session.switch.description: Switch to an existing session by ID

session.rename.description: Rename the current session. Value: new title

session.delete.description: Delete a session by ID. REQUIRES user confirmation.

session.clear_all.description: Clear legacy browser display caches only; durable server cases are retained. REQUIRES user confirmation.

browser_cache.clear.description: Clear legacy browser display caches only; durable server cases are retained. REQUIRES user confirmation.

input.ct.browse.description: Open the CT image or DICOM-series file picker

input.ctv.browse.description: Open the optional user-provided CTV mask file picker

input.oar.browse.description: Open the optional user-provided OAR mask file picker

input.dicom_rt.browse.description: Open the current case DICOM-RT (RTSTRUCT or RTDOSE) file picker

plan.run_manual_step.description: Run one manual workflow step without relying on the LLM planner

plan.reset.description: Reset the current planning session. REQUIRES user confirmation.

ui.state.description: Synchronize or inspect the current frontend UI state snapshot

ui.catalog.description: Inspect the declarative UI command catalog before choosing a control action

ui.control.description: Generic safe DOM control by a live stable ref or id. Value is normally JSON like {"ref":"dom:viewerWindow","value":450}. Use contextmenu to open the actual menu on a Data Tree/Viewer element; use increment/decrement or next/prev/first/last for numeric controls, and select for a select element. expand/collapse operates disclosure controls through their published aria-expanded state. The live UI operation catalog is authoritative; do not guess a selector.

ui.context_action.description: Execute a capability exposed by a live Data Tree or 3D scene object. Value is JSON containing the stable ref plus action_id, object_ids, category, view, or other arguments published by ui_inspector. This is the safe bridge for context-menu actions; never invent action_id or object identifiers.

tree.group.view_visibility.description: Set one Data Tree group's independent 2D or 3D visibility. Value is group,view,show|hide, for example oar,3d,hide.

training.mode.description: Start/stop live planning monitor, check status, or request detailed planning advice

manual.needle.create.description: Create an editable manual needle in the 3D viewer near the current planning target

manual.needle.endpoint.description: Move a manual needle endpoint through the existing edit/recompute path. Value is JSON such as {"needle_id":"needle_0","point_index":1,"position":[x,y,z]}

manual.seed.add.description: Add a manual seed on the selected/current manual needle and refresh dose preview

manual.seed.position.description: Move a manual seed through the existing edit/recompute path. Value is JSON such as {"seed_id":"seed_0","position":[x,y,z]}

manual.dose.recompute.description: Recompute manual dose/DVH with the trained dose_unet_spacing1mm AI dose model

manual.plan.replan.description: Replan the current manually edited needle/seed geometry with dose_unet_spacing1mm

manual.plan.finish.description: Finish/review a manual plan and provide current planning advice

system.readiness.description: Run a deterministic readiness checklist for the current case and surface missing workflow items

report.autofill.description: Auto-fill the report form from planning data

report.export.description: Export the report in the specified format

report.import.description: Open the browser file picker and import a report JSON file

report.snapshot.save.description: Save a snapshot of the current report

report.section.toggle.description: Toggle a report section open/closed. Value: section key

report.reference.add.description: Add a reference citation. Value: catalog key

report.clear.description: Clear all report data. REQUIRES user confirmation.

3d.dose_surface.description: Toggle dose-textured CTV/OAR surface mode in the 3D viewer

3d.fit.description: Fit the 3D camera to the visible meshes only. This is the camera Fit command; it does not enlarge or fullscreen the viewer card. Use viewer.fullscreen(value=3d) for the expand/maximize button.

3d.reset.description: Reset 3D camera to default position and zoom

chat.language.description: Set the UI and LLM response language

chat.theme.description: Set or toggle the global UI theme

chat.clear_history.description: Clear the current chat history. REQUIRES user confirmation.

screenshot.description: Capture a screenshot of the specified view

planning.parameter.description: Set a named planning input control. Value is JSON such as {"id":"refDirecY","value":1}; use only controls present in the current UI state.

parameter.catalog.description: Inspect the full dynamic schema of every editable UI parameter (id, label, group, type, bounds, options, current value). Groups include hyperparams, surgical_guide, viewer, colorbar, report and other.

parameter.set.description: Set any editable UI parameter by id. Value is JSON {"id":"seedRadius","value":0.5}, or an array of such entries. Consult parameter.catalog first. Setting a hyperparameter automatically applies it to the planner; setting a surgical_guide parameter persists it for the next guide generation.

planning.hyperparams.set.description: Set one or more planning hyperparameters and apply them immediately. Value is a JSON object mapping control ids to values, e.g. {"seedRadius":0.4,"seedLength":4.5,"maxIter":6}. These are the same controls shown in Input > Hyperparameters (seed geometry, volume labels, reference direction, dose limits, distance filters, iteration rates, deep-learning and RL parameters).

surgical_guide.parameters.set.description: Set puncture-guide manufacturing parameters shown in Input > Manual Fine Planning > Puncture guide parameters. Value is a JSON object using the service-side names, e.g. {"skin_threshold_hu":-300,"plate_thickness_mm":3,"channel_diameter_mm":2.2,"sleeve_outward_mm":8}. Radius fields (channel_radius_mm, sleeve_outer_radius_mm) are accepted and converted to the diameter the UI displays. Values take effect on the next guide generation.

tree.color.description: Set the display color of a data-tree node (CTV/OAR/mask/seed/needle/dose iso-surface). Value is JSON {"id":"organ_52","color":"#ff0000"}.

report.field.set.description: Set a single report form field. Value is JSON {"key":"planning.prescriptionGy","value":120} where key matches the report data path (hospital.*, patient.*, study.*, case.*, planning.*, metrics.*, signature.*, interpretation, safety, qaNotes).

report.template.set.description: Apply a report template by name (pancreas, prostate, head_neck, gynecology, liver, or empty for default).
